q1_issues.issue: The restrictor 'at the West Row' is bound with the event-side oblique (Location $h $loc) while the same query treats $h as a thing (the Theme whose value fell), and for a thing the containment preposition 'at' is prescribed as the static (LocatedIn <entity> <place>), with Location on an entity explicitly barred.

notes: The rest is right: (Name $loc "West Row") is licensed because the capitalized run exceeds the bare class word, the genitive subject of the nominalization takes Experiencer on a persistence-classed witness, During nests the fall inside it, and ReasonFor hangs on the fall. Attaching (Time $p (Year 1)) to the persistence rather than the fall is a defensible nearest-attachment reading, not a defect.
